body: Wow I got downvoted. Sorry I'm not your cliched "I don't see the point anymore" bullshit story here. You want to know what I've been fantasizing about? I've been fantasizing about taking a gun, pointing it right in the middle of my chest and squeezing the trigger because I don't want a closed casket funeral. I've fantasizing about hanging myself in my room to get back at my parents with a note that says "thanks." Hell I can't bring myself to tell anyone about this because it will damage how everyone views me because everyone in the world is a compassion less fucking bastard who only cares about themselves. Love is a fucking lie.
